blocks.zh: Chapter 10: Operational Issues | 操作問題
blocks.en: Chapter 10: Operational Issues

blocks.zh: Section 10.1 — Challenging the Area with Operational Activities | 以操作活動挑戰受測區域
blocks.en: Section 10.1 — Challenging the Area with Operational Activities

blocks.zh: 中文解析 & CDMO應用
blocks.en: Commentary & CDMO Application

blocks.zh: 操作挑戰與熱圖譜映射
blocks.en: Operational Challenges and Thermal Mapping

blocks.zh: 核心概念：操作活動挑戰
blocks.en: Core Concept: Challenging the Area with Operational Activities

blocks.zh: 熱映射研究不只是在空置、靜態的設備中放置感測器。ISPE要求在模擬真實生產條件下執行映射，以暴露潛在的溫度變化因子。
blocks.en: A thermal mapping study is not just a matter of placing sensors in an empty, static unit. ISPE expects mapping to be performed under simulated real production conditions so that potential sources of temperature variation are exposed.

blocks.zh: 這等同於在「最接近實際使用場景」的條件下驗證設備性能。
blocks.en: This amounts to verifying equipment performance under the conditions closest to actual use.

blocks.zh: CDMO共用冷藏室裝載風險場景
blocks.en: Loading Risk Scenarios in a Shared CDMO Cold Room

blocks.zh: 在CDMO環境中，冷藏室通常同時存放來自多個客戶的產品，裝載風險更為複雜：
blocks.en: In a CDMO, a cold room usually holds products from several clients at the same time, which makes loading risks more complex:

blocks.zh: 場景1：多客戶同時存取 — 不同班次的操作員頻繁進出，若無vinyl curtain，每次開門都會造成熱侵入
blocks.en: Scenario 1: Simultaneous access by multiple clients — operators on different shifts go in and out frequently; without a vinyl curtain, every door opening causes heat ingress

blocks.zh: 場景2：大批量裝載進入 — 大量托盤同時裝入可能暫時阻擋冷風循環，形成局部熱點
blocks.en: Scenario 2: Large-volume loading — loading many pallets at once can temporarily block cold air circulation and create local hot spots

blocks.zh: 場景3：叉車進入造成氣流擾動 — 叉車引擎散熱 + 門口開啟同時發生，放大溫度衝擊
blocks.en: Scenario 3: Forklift entry disturbing airflow — forklift engine heat and an open door occur together, amplifying the temperature impact

blocks.zh: 場景4：非工作時間的最低頻率開門 — 凌晨班次進出頻率不同，代表最差情況(worst case)未必在白天
blocks.en: Scenario 4: Lowest-frequency door openings outside working hours — access patterns on the early-morning shift differ, so the worst case is not necessarily during the day

blocks.zh: 練習思考 1/3
blocks.en: Practice Question 1/3

blocks.zh: Q：您的設施在進行冷藏室熱映射時，是否模擬了叉車進入及多次連續開門的場景？如果沒有，映射結果可能存在什麼風險？
blocks.en: Q: When your facility performs thermal mapping of a cold room, does it simulate forklift entry and several consecutive door openings? If not, what risks could the mapping results carry?

blocks.zh: 提示：思考「驗證的場景」與「實際操作的場景」之間的差距（validation gap）對產品安全性的影響。
blocks.en: Hint: Consider how the gap between the validated scenario and the actual operating scenario (the validation gap) affects product safety.

blocks.zh: Section 10.2 — Open Door Recovery Test | 開門恢復測試
blocks.en: Section 10.2 — Open Door Recovery Test

blocks.zh: 開門恢復測試詳解
blocks.en: Open Door Recovery Test in Detail

blocks.zh: 為何選擇「最小/無負載」作為最差情況？
blocks.en: Why Is Minimum/No Load the Worst Case?

blocks.zh: 熱質量(thermal mass)越大，設備抵抗溫度波動的能力越強。若測試時使用空倉（最小熱質量），任何熱侵入都會被快速放大，反映最差情況。
blocks.en: The greater the thermal mass, the better a unit resists temperature swings. If the test is run with an empty chamber (minimum thermal mass), any heat ingress is amplified quickly, which represents the worst case.

blocks.zh: 這與工廠驗收測試(FAT/SAT)的邏輯一致：在最容易失敗的條件下驗證，通過才代表真正的品質保證。
blocks.en: This is consistent with the logic of factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT): verify under the conditions most likely to fail, because only then does a pass give real quality assurance.

blocks.zh: 開門緩衝時間 (Buffering Time) — 操作意義
blocks.en: Door Buffering Time: Operational Meaning

blocks.zh: 開門恢復測試的關鍵輸出是開門允許時間上限，這個數字必須轉化為：
blocks.en: The key output of the open door recovery test is the maximum permitted door-open time. This figure must be translated into:

blocks.zh: SOP中明確規定的「最大開門時間」
blocks.en: A clearly stated "maximum door-open time" in the SOP

blocks.zh: 作業員訓練的考核項目
blocks.en: An assessment item in operator training

blocks.zh: CAPA追蹤的偏差觸發條件
blocks.en: A deviation trigger condition for CAPA tracking

blocks.zh: 如果SOP只寫「盡速關門」而沒有具體時間限制，等同於沒有控制。
blocks.en: If the SOP only says "close the door as soon as possible" without a specific time limit, it is effectively no control at all.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 2/3
blocks.en: Practice Question 2/3

blocks.zh: Q：您的SOP中是否明訂冷藏室最大開門時間？這個時間是基於開門恢復測試數據還是僅憑經驗設定？
blocks.en: Q: Does your SOP specify a maximum door-open time for the cold room? Is that time based on open door recovery test data, or set by experience alone?

blocks.zh: 延伸：若冷藏室安裝了vinyl curtain，開門時間限制是否可以放寬？放寬的前提是什麼？
blocks.en: Extension: If the cold room has a vinyl curtain, can the door-open time limit be relaxed? On what conditions?

blocks.en: Section 10.3 — Power Outage / Thermal Degradation Test

blocks.en: Power Outage Response and Product Disposition

blocks.zh: CDMO視角：停電測試的業務連續性價值
blocks.en: CDMO Perspective: Business Continuity Value of the Power Outage Test

blocks.zh:
停電測試的輸出直接回答一個關鍵問題：
「如果備援電源完全失效，我有多少時間可以轉移產品？」
blocks.en:
The output of the power outage test directly answers one key question:
"If backup power fails completely, how much time do I have to move the product?"

blocks.zh: 2°C–8°C冷藏室：典型空倉衰減時間可能只有30–60分鐘
blocks.en: 2°C–8°C cold room: a typical empty-chamber decay time may be only 30–60 minutes

blocks.zh: -20°C冷凍庫：空倉衰減時間可能達2–4小時（但滿倉更長）
blocks.en: -20°C freezer: an empty-chamber decay time may reach 2–4 hours (and is longer when fully loaded)

blocks.zh: 這些數據必須納入業務連續性計畫(BCP)和緊急應變程序(ERP)
blocks.en: These data must be built into the business continuity plan (BCP) and emergency response procedure (ERP)

blocks.zh: 練習思考 3/3
blocks.en: Practice Question 3/3

blocks.zh: Q：您的設施是否有停電測試數據支撐緊急程序？如果備援電源在凌晨2點失效，值班人員能在多少分鐘內收到通知並採取行動？
blocks.en: Q: Does your facility have power outage test data to support its emergency procedures? If backup power fails at 2 a.m., within how many minutes can the on-duty staff be notified and take action?

blocks.zh: 情境延伸：若停電發生時冷藏室中存放的是某客戶的臨床試驗用藥，停電後2小時才發現，QA應如何評估產品可用性？
blocks.en: Scenario extension: If the cold room holds a client's clinical trial material when the power fails, and the outage is discovered only 2 hours later, how should QA assess product usability?

blocks.zh: Sections 10.4–10.5 — Calibration Strategies, Access Control & Dehumidification | 校準策略、進出管制與除濕
blocks.en: Sections 10.4–10.5 — Calibration Strategies, Access Control & Dehumidification

blocks.zh: 校準策略與進出管制深度解析
blocks.en: Calibration Strategies and Access Control in Depth

blocks.zh: 三層校準策略框架
blocks.en: Three-Tier Calibration Strategy Framework

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：監測感測器的校準標準高於控制感測器，因為監測數據是產品放行的依據。
blocks.en: Key principle: monitoring sensors are held to a higher calibration standard than control sensors, because monitoring data are the basis for product release.

blocks.zh: 校準召回追蹤系統 (Calibration Recall System)
blocks.en: Calibration Recall Tracking System

blocks.zh: 一個有效的校準召回系統應包含：
blocks.en: An effective calibration recall system should include:

blocks.zh: 儀器清冊(Asset Register)：每個感測器均有唯一ID、位置、校準週期、上次校準日期
blocks.en: Asset register: every sensor has a unique ID, location, calibration interval and last calibration date

blocks.zh: 到期提醒：提前30天發送警示給校準工程師和QA
blocks.en: Due-date reminders: a warning is sent to the calibration engineer and QA 30 days in advance

blocks.zh: 逾期鎖定：超過校準有效期的感測器自動標記，其數據不得用於放行決策
blocks.en: Overdue lock-out: sensors past their calibration validity are flagged automatically, and their data must not be used for release decisions

blocks.zh: 回溯評估：感測器超過校準期間若有偏差，需評估期間所有產品的影響
blocks.en: Retrospective assessment: if a sensor is found out of tolerance after its calibration period has lapsed, the impact on all product stored during that period must be assessed

blocks.zh: 替換驗證：校準後感測器重新安裝需確認讀值與同位置其他感測器的一致性
blocks.en: Verification after replacement: after calibration, a reinstalled sensor must be checked for agreement with the other sensors at the same location

blocks.zh: 進出管制的GMP意義
blocks.en: GMP Significance of Access Control

blocks.zh: 進出管制不只是安全問題，也是GMP合規問題。未授權進入可能導致：
blocks.en: Access control is not only a security matter but also a GMP compliance matter. Unauthorized entry may lead to:

blocks.zh: 產品被未記錄的方式取出（影響庫存完整性）
blocks.en: Product being removed in an undocumented way (affecting inventory integrity)

blocks.zh: 不當操作造成溫度偏差（門被長時間打開）
blocks.en: Improper operation causing temperature deviations (door held open for a long time)

blocks.zh: 訪客接觸未貼標籤產品（交叉污染風險）
blocks.en: Visitors coming into contact with unlabeled product (cross-contamination risk)

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68 和 EU GMP Annex 15均要求儲存區域有適當的進出控制。
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68 and EU GMP Annex 15 both require appropriate access control for storage areas.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Question

blocks.zh: Q：您的設施中，監測感測器(monitoring sensor)和控制感測器(control sensor)是否有不同的校準頻率規定？如果兩者都使用年度校準，這樣的做法是否符合ISPE的差異化要求？
blocks.en: Q: In your facility, are different calibration frequencies specified for monitoring sensors and control sensors? If both are calibrated annually, does that meet ISPE's expectation of differentiation?

blocks.zh: Chapter 11: Packaged Transport Systems | 包裝運輸系統
blocks.en: Chapter 11: Packaged Transport Systems

blocks.zh: Sections 11.1 — Active Shipping Containers: Unit Load Devices (ULD) | 主動式運輸容器：單位裝載設備
blocks.en: Section 11.1 — Active Shipping Containers: Unit Load Devices (ULD)

blocks.zh: 主動式ULD運輸容器資格認證
blocks.en: Qualification of Active ULD Shipping Containers

blocks.zh: 單機資格 vs. 供應商評估：選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Unit-by-Unit Qualification vs. Supplier Assessment: Selection Logic

blocks.zh: 選單機資格：當ULD由同一家供應商長期租用，數量固定，可針對每台設備建立獨立的資格文件。適合高價值/高風險產品。
blocks.en: Choose unit-by-unit qualification: when ULDs are leased long term from the same supplier in a fixed quantity, so that separate qualification documentation can be built for each unit. Suitable for high-value/high-risk products.

blocks.zh: 選供應商評估：當ULD數量龐大或頻繁更換，個別映射不切實際。透過審核製造商設計和服務商維護品質，輔以隨貨數據記錄器作為補充保證。
blocks.en: Choose supplier assessment: when the ULD fleet is large or units are replaced frequently, so individual mapping is impractical. Audit the manufacturer's design and the service provider's maintenance quality, supplemented by data loggers accompanying each shipment as additional assurance.

blocks.zh: 關鍵補充措施：無論採哪種方法，每次運輸都應附帶獨立的溫度記錄器，這是最後一道確認機制。
blocks.en: Key supplementary measure: whichever approach is used, every shipment should carry an independent temperature recorder, which serves as the last line of confirmation.

blocks.zh: 冷鏈交接點 (Hand-off Points) 風險
blocks.en: Cold Chain Hand-off Point Risks

blocks.zh: 從設施到最終目的地的冷鏈中，最脆弱的環節通常是交接點：
blocks.en: In the cold chain from the facility to the final destination, the most vulnerable links are usually the hand-off points:

blocks.zh: 設施倉庫 → 快遞取貨：產品在裝卸區暴露時間
blocks.en: Facility warehouse → courier pickup: product exposure time at the loading dock

blocks.zh: 機場地面操作：從貨倉到飛機貨艙的轉移時間
blocks.en: Airport ground handling: transfer time from the cargo warehouse to the aircraft hold

blocks.zh: 轉機點：兩段航班之間的等待時間
blocks.en: Transit points: waiting time between two flight legs

blocks.zh: 目的地機場 → 客戶設施：最後一哩配送
blocks.en: Destination airport → customer facility: last-mile delivery

blocks.zh: 每個交接點都應有明確的溫度確認程序和責任分工協議(Quality Agreement)。
blocks.en: Each hand-off point should have a clear temperature confirmation procedure and a division of responsibilities set out in a quality agreement.

blocks.zh: Q：您的設施在使用ULD運輸臨床試驗用藥時，採用的是單機資格還是供應商評估方式？隨貨溫度記錄器的數據是否有人系統性地審查，還是只在收貨時檢查一下就歸檔？
blocks.en: Q: When your facility ships clinical trial material by ULD, does it use unit-by-unit qualification or supplier assessment? Does anyone systematically review the data from the accompanying temperature recorder, or is it only checked on receipt and then filed?

blocks.zh: Sections 11.2–11.5 — Temperature Controlled Trailers: Design, Insulation & Validation | 溫控拖車：設計、隔熱與驗證
blocks.en: Sections 11.2–11.5 — Temperature Controlled Trailers: Design, Insulation & Validation

blocks.zh: 溫控拖車驗證策略與CTC比較
blocks.en: Temperature Controlled Trailer Validation Strategy Compared with CTCs

blocks.zh: 比喻：為什麼F級拖車成功也意味著DF級會成功？
blocks.en: Analogy: Why Does Success with an F-Class Trailer Also Mean Success with a DF-Class Trailer?

blocks.zh: ISPE指出，在F級拖車上成功完成的驗證研究，也意味著DF級(深冷凍)拖車同樣適用。
blocks.en: ISPE notes that a validation study successfully completed on an F-class trailer also applies to a DF-class (deep frozen) trailer.

blocks.zh: 這就像汽車安全測試：如果一輛配備標準安全設備的車通過了碰撞測試，那麼裝備更多安全功能的高配版車款自然也能通過 — 因為F級是市場主流且絕緣能力更低，通過代表更高標準的DF也能達標。
blocks.en: It is like car safety testing: if a car with standard safety equipment passes a crash test, a higher-spec model with more safety features will naturally pass as well. F-class is the mainstream market choice and has lower insulation capability, so passing means the higher-standard DF class can also meet the requirement.

blocks.zh: 隔熱衰退的實務意義
blocks.en: Practical Meaning of Insulation Degradation

blocks.zh: 聚氨酯泡沫的隔熱性能會隨時間下降（發泡劑氣體逸散 → 空氣和水蒸氣取代），這意味著：
blocks.en: The insulating performance of polyurethane foam declines over time (blowing agent gas escapes and is replaced by air and water vapor), which means:

blocks.zh: 新拖車的初始性能 ≠ 使用5–10年後的性能
blocks.en: The initial performance of a new trailer ≠ its performance after 5–10 years of use

blocks.zh: 驗證研究應考慮設備年齡和使用歷史
blocks.en: Validation studies should consider equipment age and usage history

blocks.zh: 定期熱掃描(thermal scanning)可早期發現隔熱劣化
blocks.en: Periodic thermal scanning can detect insulation deterioration early

blocks.zh: 質量協議應要求承運商定期提供拖車維護記錄
blocks.en: The quality agreement should require the carrier to provide trailer maintenance records regularly

blocks.zh: Q：您的設施使用溫控拖車進行產品配送時，是否與承運商簽訂品質協議？該協議是否涵蓋拖車的TMC/ATP認證等級要求、定期檢查標準，以及溫度超規時的通報程序？
blocks.en: Q: When your facility uses temperature controlled trailers for product distribution, do you have a quality agreement with the carrier? Does the agreement cover the required TMC/ATP certification class of the trailer, periodic inspection standards, and the notification procedure when temperature goes out of specification?

blocks.zh: Section 11.6 — Trailer Loading Patterns & Inspectional Criteria | 拖車裝載模式與檢查標準
blocks.en: Section 11.6 — Trailer Loading Patterns & Inspectional Criteria

blocks.zh: 裝載模式對溫度均一性的關鍵影響
blocks.en: Critical Effect of Loading Pattern on Temperature Uniformity

blocks.zh: 裝載模式的三大原則
blocks.en: Three Principles of Loading Patterns

blocks.zh: 原則1 — 氣流暢通：托盤之間必須保留足夠間距讓冷空氣循環，阻擋氣流等同於阻擋溫度調節能力
blocks.en: Principle 1: Clear airflow — leave enough space between pallets for cold air to circulate; blocking airflow is the same as blocking temperature control capacity

blocks.zh: 原則2 — 不接觸側壁：拖車側壁是熱交換最強的區域（尤其夏季），接觸側壁的產品最容易超出溫度範圍
blocks.en: Principle 2: Keep clear of the side walls — the trailer side walls are where heat exchange is strongest (especially in summer), so product touching the side walls is the most likely to go out of temperature range

blocks.zh: 原則3 — 預冷後才裝載：裝載未冷卻至目標溫度的產品，等同於在拖車內引入一個熱源，增加冷機負擔
blocks.en: Principle 3: Pre-cool before loading — loading product that has not reached target temperature introduces a heat source into the trailer and adds load on the refrigeration unit

blocks.zh: 每次使用前的拖車檢查清單
blocks.en: Pre-Use Trailer Inspection Checklist

blocks.zh: 空氣分配導管(air distribution chute)完整無損
blocks.en: Air distribution chute intact and undamaged

blocks.zh: 送風口、回風口、地板排水孔無堵塞
blocks.en: Supply air vents, return air vents and floor drain holes not blocked

blocks.zh: 內外側壁無叉車造成的穿孔或凹陷
blocks.en: No forklift punctures or dents in the interior and exterior walls

blocks.zh: 門封條(door seals)完整，無裂縫或破損
blocks.en: Door seals intact, with no cracks or damage

blocks.zh: 整體清潔度符合要求（無異物、無前次貨物殘留）
blocks.en: Overall cleanliness acceptable (no foreign matter, no residue from a previous load)

blocks.zh: 冷機組(reefer unit)正常運轉，設定點正確
blocks.en: Refrigeration (reefer) unit operating normally, with the correct set point

blocks.zh: 拖車內部溫度已達到目標範圍
blocks.en: Trailer interior temperature has reached the target range

blocks.zh: TMC/ATP認證標牌可見且在有效期內
blocks.en: TMC/ATP certification plate visible and within its validity period

blocks.zh: Q：您的設施在出貨前是否有書面的拖車檢查記錄？若承運商提供的拖車門封條出現輕微裂縫但拖車溫度仍在範圍內，您會如何決策：使用這台拖車還是要求更換？
blocks.en: Q: Does your facility keep a written trailer inspection record before shipment? If the door seal on the carrier's trailer shows a slight crack but the trailer temperature is still within range, how would you decide: use this trailer or ask for a replacement?

blocks.zh: 提示：思考「當下合格」與「長途運輸過程中的潛在風險」之間的平衡。
blocks.en: Hint: Consider the balance between "acceptable right now" and the potential risk during a long-distance journey.

blocks.zh: Chapter 12: Maintenance | 維護
blocks.en: Chapter 12: Maintenance

blocks.zh: Sections 12.1–12.4 — Coils, Condensate, Functional Testing & Leak Testing | 盤管、冷凝管、功能測試與洩漏測試
blocks.en: Sections 12.1–12.4 — Coils, Condensate, Functional Testing & Leak Testing

blocks.zh: 盤管、冷凝管與洩漏測試詳解
blocks.en: Coils, Condensate Lines and Leak Testing in Detail

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察：製造商建議 ≠ GMP要求
blocks.en: Key Insight: Manufacturer Recommendations ≠ GMP Requirements

blocks.zh: ISPE明確指出，設備製造商的維護建議通常不考慮高價值藥品儲存的特殊需求。這意味著：
blocks.en: ISPE states clearly that an equipment manufacturer's maintenance recommendations usually do not take into account the special needs of high-value pharmaceutical storage. This means:

blocks.zh: 製造商建議可能是基於食品或一般工業應用
blocks.en: Manufacturer recommendations may be based on food or general industrial applications

blocks.zh: GMP環境下的維護頻率和標準必須由使用方（CDMO）自行評估和設定
blocks.en: In a GMP environment, maintenance frequency and standards must be evaluated and set by the user (the CDMO)

blocks.zh: 維護計畫必須考慮「若此設備失效，對產品品質的影響是什麼？」
blocks.en: The maintenance program must consider "if this equipment fails, what is the impact on product quality?"

blocks.zh: 這正是風險基礎的PM計畫的基礎：設備關鍵性 → 決定維護頻率和深度。
blocks.en: This is the foundation of a risk-based PM program: equipment criticality → determines maintenance frequency and depth.

blocks.zh: 盤管清潔的微生物風險
blocks.en: Microbial Risk in Coil Cleaning

blocks.zh: ISPE推薦乾式清潔(dry cleaning)而非濕式清潔，原因是：
blocks.en: ISPE recommends dry cleaning rather than wet cleaning, for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 濕式清潔引入水分，可能在盤管翼片(fins)上形成生物膜(biofilm)滋生環境
blocks.en: Wet cleaning introduces moisture, which can create a breeding environment for biofilm on the coil fins

blocks.zh: 冷藏室的低溫並非無菌環境 — 某些嗜冷菌(psychrotrophic bacteria)和黴菌在2–8°C下仍可緩慢生長
blocks.en: The low temperature of a cold room does not make it sterile: some psychrotrophic bacteria and molds can still grow slowly at 2–8°C

blocks.zh: 微生物污染的盤管可能通過氣流將孢子傳播至儲存產品的環境
blocks.en: A microbially contaminated coil can spread spores through the airflow into the environment where product is stored

blocks.zh: 冷媒洩漏記錄的法規要求
blocks.en: Regulatory Requirements for Refrigerant Leak Records

blocks.zh: 許多地區對冷媒使用和洩漏有強制性記錄要求：
blocks.en: Many jurisdictions have mandatory record requirements for refrigerant use and leakage:

blocks.zh: 歐盟 F-Gas Regulation (EU 517/2014)：含氟冷媒超過一定量需定期洩漏檢查並記錄
blocks.en: EU F-Gas Regulation (EU 517/2014): fluorinated refrigerants above a certain quantity require periodic leak checks and records

blocks.zh: EPA Section 608 (美國)：ODS冷媒洩漏超過閾值需修復並記錄
blocks.en: EPA Section 608 (US): leaks of ODS refrigerants above the threshold must be repaired and recorded

blocks.zh: GMP視角：冷媒洩漏可能污染產品，且洩漏事件可能影響設備效能，進而影響儲存溫度
blocks.en: GMP perspective: a refrigerant leak may contaminate product, and a leak event may affect equipment performance and in turn storage temperature

blocks.zh: 冷媒記錄(refrigerant log)應成為PM文件系統的一部分。
blocks.en: The refrigerant log should be part of the PM documentation system.

blocks.zh: Q：您的冷藏設備上次盤管清潔是什麼時候？清潔記錄是否包含了「清潔前/後目視檢查結果」以及清潔方法？如果不是乾式清潔，是否評估過微生物污染風險？
blocks.en: Q: When were the coils on your refrigeration equipment last cleaned? Does the cleaning record include the visual inspection results before and after cleaning, and the cleaning method? If dry cleaning was not used, was the microbial contamination risk assessed?

blocks.zh: Sections 12.5–12.6 — Thermal Scanning & System Alarms | 熱掃描與系統警報
blocks.en: Sections 12.5–12.6 — Thermal Scanning & System Alarms

blocks.zh: 熱掃描、警報系統與重新映射觸發條件
blocks.en: Thermal Scanning, Alarm Systems and Remapping Triggers

blocks.zh: 熱掃描(Thermal Scanning) — 非破壞性隔熱檢測
blocks.en: Thermal Scanning: Non-Destructive Insulation Inspection

blocks.zh: 紅外熱成像(Infrared Thermography)可在不拆除板材的情況下，透過溫度差異識別隔熱劣化區域：
blocks.en: Infrared thermography can identify areas of insulation deterioration from temperature differences without removing panels:

blocks.zh: 正常隔熱：表面溫度均勻，無明顯熱橋
blocks.en: Normal insulation: uniform surface temperature, no obvious thermal bridges

blocks.zh: 隔熱劣化：面板某區域出現「熱點」，代表冷橋或隔熱材料受損
blocks.en: Degraded insulation: a "hot spot" appears in an area of the panel, indicating a cold bridge or damaged insulation material

blocks.zh: 門封條洩漏：門框周圍出現溫度梯度異常
blocks.en: Door seal leakage: abnormal temperature gradients around the door frame

blocks.zh: 管道穿牆處：若密封不良，凝結水會沿管道滲入
blocks.en: Pipe wall penetrations: if poorly sealed, condensation will seep in along the pipe

blocks.zh: 建議：熱掃描應在設備滿載運行時進行，內外溫差最大，最容易發現問題。
blocks.en: Recommendation: perform thermal scanning while the unit is running fully loaded, when the temperature difference between inside and outside is greatest and problems are easiest to detect.

blocks.zh: 警報測試的GMP要求
blocks.en: GMP Requirements for Alarm Testing

blocks.zh: 「定期測試警報」不只是技術要求，更是GMP合規要求。一個從未被測試的警報系統，在真正需要時可能完全失效。
blocks.en: "Test alarms periodically" is not only a technical requirement but also a GMP compliance requirement. An alarm system that has never been tested may fail completely when it is actually needed.

blocks.zh: 測試方式：直接溫度變化（模擬真實偏差）或受控模擬（注入測試信號）
blocks.en: Test method: a direct temperature change (simulating a real deviation) or a controlled simulation (injecting a test signal)

blocks.zh: 測試範圍：本地聲光警報 + 遠端通報（Email/SMS/Phone）
blocks.en: Test scope: local audible/visual alarm + remote notification (email/SMS/phone)

blocks.zh: 文件要求：測試結果必須記錄，包含測試時間、觸發條件、通報到達時間
blocks.en: Documentation requirement: test results must be recorded, including the test time, trigger condition and notification arrival time

blocks.zh: Response time目標：從警報觸發到有人確認，應有明確的期望時間
blocks.en: Response time target: there should be a clearly defined expected time from alarm trigger to someone acknowledging it

blocks.zh: 維護數據 → 減少重新映射需求
blocks.en: Maintenance Data → Reduced Remapping Need

blocks.zh: ISPE提供了一個重要的生命週期管理原則：如果系統維護記錄良好，且監測數據顯示性能穩定，可以減少重新熱映射的頻率。
blocks.en: ISPE provides an important lifecycle management principle: if the system's maintenance records are good and monitoring data show stable performance, the frequency of thermal remapping can be reduced.

blocks.zh: 這需要SME（主題專家）定期審查：
blocks.en: This requires periodic review by an SME (subject matter expert) of:

blocks.zh: 監測數據趨勢 vs. 資格認證時的基準數據
blocks.en: Monitoring data trends vs. the baseline data from qualification

blocks.zh: 警報歷史記錄（是否出現新的偏差模式？）
blocks.en: Alarm history (are new deviation patterns appearing?)

blocks.zh: 維護歷史（是否有影響性能的重大維修？）
blocks.en: Maintenance history (have there been major repairs that affect performance?)

blocks.zh: 設備年齡和隔熱衰退評估
blocks.en: Equipment age and insulation degradation assessment

blocks.zh: 相反地，若出現以下情況，必須觸發重新映射：重大維修更換（壓縮機、冷凝器）、設備搬遷、性能數據顯示明顯趨勢偏移。
blocks.en: Conversely, remapping must be triggered in the following cases: major repair or replacement (compressor, condenser), relocation of the unit, or performance data showing a clear trend shift.

blocks.zh: Q：您的設施上次警報系統測試是什麼時候？測試記錄是否涵蓋了遠端通報渠道（SMS/Email）的響應確認？若值班人員更換了手機號碼，警報通報系統是否會自動更新？
blocks.en: Q: When was your facility's alarm system last tested? Does the test record cover confirmation of response through the remote notification channels (SMS/email)? If on-duty staff change their phone numbers, does the alarm notification system update automatically?

blocks.zh: PM by Equipment Type + Calibration Recall System + PM Frequency Table | 依設備類型的PM程序 + 校準召回系統 + PM頻率表
blocks.en: PM by Equipment Type + Calibration Recall System + PM Frequency Table

blocks.zh: 中文解析 & PM計畫設計
blocks.en: Commentary & PM Program Design

blocks.zh: 預防性維護計畫要素與頻率表
blocks.en: Elements of a Preventive Maintenance Program and Frequency Table

blocks.zh: PM頻率建議表 | PM Frequency Reference
blocks.en: PM Frequency Reference

blocks.zh: PM計畫完整要素清單
blocks.en: Complete Checklist of PM Program Elements

blocks.zh: 設備清冊：每台設備有唯一ID、型號、安裝日期、關鍵性等級
blocks.en: Equipment register: each unit has a unique ID, model, installation date and criticality level

blocks.zh: PM時間表：基於設備關鍵性和製造商建議的頻率設定
blocks.en: PM schedule: frequencies set on the basis of equipment criticality and manufacturer recommendations

blocks.zh: PM工作單(Work Order)：清晰的步驟指示、所需工具和備件
blocks.en: PM work order: clear step-by-step instructions, required tools and spare parts

blocks.zh: 維護記錄：每次PM的執行人、日期、發現事項、措施
blocks.en: Maintenance records: for each PM, the person who performed it, the date, findings and actions

blocks.zh: 逾期PM追蹤：PM逾期時的升級通報機制
blocks.en: Overdue PM tracking: an escalation and notification mechanism when a PM becomes overdue

blocks.zh: PM影響評估：重大PM對溫度映射有效性的影響評估
blocks.en: PM impact assessment: assessment of the effect of major PM on the validity of the temperature mapping

blocks.zh: 備件管理：關鍵備件庫存（過濾器、密封條、保險絲）
blocks.en: Spare parts management: inventory of critical spares (filters, seals, fuses)

blocks.zh: 供應商認證：外包維護供應商的資格和品質協議
blocks.en: Supplier qualification: qualification of outsourced maintenance providers and quality agreements

blocks.zh: 校準整合：PM時同步確認感測器校準狀態
blocks.en: Calibration integration: confirm the sensor calibration status at the same time as PM

blocks.zh: CAPA整合：PM中發現的問題直接進入CAPA系統
blocks.en: CAPA integration: problems found during PM go directly into the CAPA system

blocks.zh: 溫度偏差評估決策樹
blocks.en: Temperature Excursion Assessment Decision Tree

blocks.zh: Temperature Excursion Assessment Protocol | 溫度超規評估流程
blocks.en: Temperature Excursion Assessment Protocol

blocks.zh: 溫度偏差(Excursion)產品影響評估決策樹
blocks.en: Decision Tree for Product Impact Assessment of a Temperature Excursion

blocks.zh: 1. 警報觸發或監測數據顯示溫度超規 — 是否已記錄偏差時間和持續時間？
blocks.en: 1. Alarm triggered or monitoring data show a temperature excursion: have the deviation time and duration been recorded?

blocks.zh: 否 → 立即記錄發現時間，估算最長可能暴露時間（最差情況）
blocks.en: No → immediately record the time of discovery and estimate the maximum possible exposure time (worst case)

blocks.zh: 是 → 進入步驟2
blocks.en: Yes → go to step 2

blocks.zh: 2. 超規溫度和持續時間是否在產品說明書(SmPC)的允許累積暴露範圍內？
blocks.en: 2. Are the excursion temperature and duration within the cumulative exposure allowed in the product information (SmPC)?

blocks.zh: 是 → 記錄評估結論，確認後續監測加強，開立輕微偏差報告
blocks.en: Yes → record the assessment conclusion, confirm enhanced follow-up monitoring, and open a minor deviation report

blocks.zh: 否 → 進入步驟3（產品隔離）
blocks.en: No → go to step 3 (product quarantine)

blocks.zh: 3. 立即隔離涉及批次，通知QA和產品SME，開立主要偏差報告
blocks.en: 3. Immediately quarantine the affected batches, notify QA and the product SME, and open a major deviation report

blocks.zh: 4. 是否有已核准的超標穩定性數據(out-of-storage stability data)支撐產品可用性？
blocks.en: 4. Is there approved out-of-storage stability data supporting product usability?

blocks.zh: 是 → QA審查數據，若支持 → 有條件放行或縮短有效期
blocks.en: Yes → QA reviews the data; if supportive → conditional release or shortened shelf life

blocks.zh: 否 → 進入步驟5
blocks.en: No → go to step 5

blocks.zh: 5. 是否可進行額外穩定性測試評估產品品質？
blocks.en: 5. Can additional stability testing be performed to assess product quality?

blocks.zh: 是 → 送樣測試，結果支持則有條件放行，否則廢棄
blocks.en: Yes → send samples for testing; if results are supportive, conditional release, otherwise discard

blocks.zh: 否 → 廢棄受影響批次，完整CAPA分析，根本原因調查
blocks.en: No → discard the affected batches, perform a full CAPA analysis and root cause investigation

blocks.zh: 6. 無論最終決定，必須識別根本原因並實施CAPA，評估是否需要觸發重新映射
blocks.en: 6. Whatever the final decision, the root cause must be identified and CAPA implemented, and whether remapping needs to be triggered must be assessed

blocks.zh: 練習思考（綜合題）
blocks.en: Practice Questions (Comprehensive)

blocks.zh: 情境：週五深夜，2°C–8°C冷藏室溫度升至12°C，持續了4小時才有人察覺。室內存放了3個批次的生物製劑原液，其中一批是客戶即將用於III期臨床試驗的關鍵批次。
blocks.en: Scenario: Late on a Friday night, the temperature in a 2°C–8°C cold room rises to 12°C and stays there for 4 hours before anyone notices. The room holds 3 batches of biologic drug substance, one of which is a critical batch the client is about to use in a Phase III clinical trial.

blocks.zh: Q1：您的第一個行動是什麼？（提示：思考時間線重建）
blocks.en: Q1: What is your first action? (Hint: think about reconstructing the timeline)

blocks.zh: Q2：產品說明書上寫「2–8°C儲存，避免超過25°C」，這是否足以判定這4小時偏差是否影響產品品質？
blocks.en: Q2: The product information says "Store at 2–8°C; do not exceed 25°C." Is this enough to decide whether the 4-hour excursion affected product quality?

blocks.zh: Q3：這次偏差是否應觸發冷藏室重新映射？判斷依據是什麼？
blocks.en: Q3: Should this excursion trigger remapping of the cold room? On what basis would you decide?

blocks.zh: PM事件對映射有效性的影響評估 | PM Impact on Qualification Status
blocks.en: PM Impact on Qualification Status

blocks.zh: Section Summary & Key Takeaways | 章節總結與關鍵要點
blocks.en: Section Summary & Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: Chapters 10–12 Integrated Learning | 第10–12章整合學習
blocks.en: Chapters 10–12 Integrated Learning

blocks.zh: 整合應用：CDMO Operations Director視角
blocks.en: Integrated Application: The CDMO Operations Director's Perspective

blocks.zh: 「已完成映射但維護不當的設備，其映射結果已無法反映現實。」
blocks.en: "Equipment that has been mapped but not properly maintained no longer has mapping results that reflect reality."

blocks.zh: 從運營總監角度的三個核心問責問題
blocks.en: Three Core Accountability Questions from the Operations Director's Perspective

blocks.zh: 操作合規性：我的團隊在每次開門、裝載、進出冷藏室時，是否都遵循了基於映射數據制定的SOP？是否有監控機制確保合規？
blocks.en: Operational compliance: Does my team follow the SOPs built on mapping data every time it opens the door, loads, or enters the cold room? Is there a monitoring mechanism to ensure compliance?

blocks.zh: 維護完整性：我的PM計畫是否真正基於設備關鍵性設計？最近一次PM逾期是什麼時候？逾期期間的產品狀態是否有評估？
blocks.en: Maintenance integrity: Is my PM program truly designed on the basis of equipment criticality? When was the most recent overdue PM? Was the product status during the overdue period assessed?

blocks.zh: 系統可靠性：如果今晚凌晨3點發生停電，我的警報系統是否會在5分鐘內通知到正確的人？我有多久沒有測試這個假設了？
blocks.en: System reliability: If a power outage occurs at 3 a.m. tonight, will my alarm system notify the right people within 5 minutes? How long has it been since I tested that assumption?

blocks.zh: 映射 → 操作 → 維護的生命週期閉環
blocks.en: The Mapping → Operation → Maintenance Lifecycle Loop

blocks.zh:
熱映射建立基準
(Thermal Mapping)
blocks.en:
Thermal mapping establishes the baseline
(Thermal Mapping)

blocks.zh:
操作程序基於映射數據
SOP開門時間、裝載規範
blocks.en:
Operating procedures based on mapping data
SOP door-open time, loading rules

blocks.zh:
PM計畫維持設備性能
確保映射條件不改變
blocks.en:
PM program maintains equipment performance
Ensures mapping conditions do not change

blocks.zh: 場景：您剛接任CDMO的QA副總裁職位，被要求在90天內評估冷鏈GMP合規狀態。
blocks.en: Scenario: You have just taken up the post of QA Vice President at a CDMO and are asked to assess the cold chain GMP compliance status within 90 days.

blocks.zh: 基於Chapters 10–12，您的前15天優先審查清單包含哪些？
blocks.en: Based on Chapters 10–12, what does your priority review list for the first 15 days include?

blocks.zh: 請思考：(1) 操作合規性文件審查 (2) PM記錄完整性 (3) 校準召回狀態 (4) 警報測試記錄 (5) 最近偏差的根本原因分析品質 (6) 承運商品質協議覆蓋範圍
blocks.en: Consider: (1) review of operational compliance documentation (2) completeness of PM records (3) calibration recall status (4) alarm test records (5) quality of root cause analysis for recent deviations (6) coverage of carrier quality agreements
